# Signal Loom closure record
Date: 20 February 2026

## Project closure
The installation is complete and archived. There is no active development intention and no agreed next task.

## Calibration closure
The pressure-hold calibration was performed on 13 February. Its adjustment resolved the drift, and the repeated hold check passed. The calibration task is completed and drift is not a current blocker.

## Archived configuration
The archived installation uses the pressure pad and fabric diffuser. The rotary dial and glass screen were not restored.

## Conditional future
An outdoor version using weather data remains only a conditional possibility if the project is reopened. Reopening has not been agreed.

## Feedback availability
No tutor, visitor or external reviewer feedback was collected before closure.
